alex: Quick ping — PR <https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4321|#4321> is ready for merge but touches auth proxy + VPC egress. Need sec sign-off before we flip the flag. PTAL :eyes:

maria: Linking it now. Is there any new secret material or KMS path changes?

alex: No new plaintext secrets. Added env var `ONPREM_KMS_PATH` (reference only) and a small policy tweak to `egress_vpc_cidr`. All values read from k8s secret refs, not committed. Diff snippet: ```yaml
env:
  - name: ONPREM_KMS_PATH
    valueFrom:
      secretKeyRef:
        name: onprem-kms
        key: path
```

jess: Thanks. Can you add a short threat-model note + e2e smoke steps in the PR description? We need a runbook for rollback if the VPC routing misbehaves.

alex: Done — added "Rollback: set FEATURE_ONPREM=false and restart proxy" and `make smoke-onprem` steps. Also added expected logs to watch: `proxy: routing -> onprem` and `egress: allowed_cidr=`.

kevin: Ops prefer we schedule merge for the maintenance window tomorrow 10:00-12:00 PT. Any reason not to wait?

maria: I can review tonight, should be quick. If security signs off I'll be around for the deploy window.

security-bot: secret-scan: no findings in changed files (scan v2.4). :white_check_mark:

jess: Looks fine from security perspective. Verify smoke run and confirm no unexpected egress to prod CIDRs. I left one nit about a log level. LGTM after that small change. :thumbsup:

alex: Fixed log level and reran `make smoke-onprem` — all assertions passed. No egress to prod CIDRs in the run.

alex: Plan: merge during ops window tomorrow, notify #deployments, and roll back if any `egress: denied` spikes or auth errors. I’ll also tag the PR with `sec-approved`. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
